reason: The structure is fair, worst case it is about EUR 600 per meeting and the second half is contingent, but I am not paying EUR 1,500 on the strength of a '45 meetings' line with no cost per meeting or closed revenue behind it. I would take the free sample of 15 companies and decide after that, not this month.
objection: Meetings are not contracts. My two or three salespeople are already busy with existing accounts, so someone still has to run those meetings and follow up quotes, and I have seen no proof that these meetings turn into shipments.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample names firms I actually want and the reference logistics client tells me how many of their meetings became paying accounts, and in what time, I would sign.
